text: Compose and decompose numbers 11-19 using equations (e.g., 14 = 10 + 4)

experiences.distinctContribution: Orients the non-reading kindergartener to teen numbers (11–19) using audio and visuals, framing teen numbers as a full group of 10 plus extra ones.
experiences.learnerAction: Listens to audio narration and observes visual representations of 10 items bundled together with extra individual items.
experiences.intent: Introduce teen numbers 11-19 with an engaging scenario about a bakery packing boxes of 10 cupcakes and placing loose cupcakes beside them.
evidenceLimits: Provides context and orientation only; does not record learner responses or assess equation generation.
experiences.support: Audio narration reads hook prompts aloud for pre-readers.

experiences.distinctContribution: Demonstrates visually and verbally how 14 is composed of a full ten-frame (10) and 4 ones, linking the visual parts to the equation 14 = 10 + 4.
experiences.learnerAction: Watches animated transformation where 10 dots fill a ten-frame, 4 loose dots sit beside it, and the equation 14 = 10 + 4 appears with highlighted corresponding parts.
experiences.intent: Model the concept that every teen number 11-19 decomposes into 10 and some ones, explicitly mapping each part of the equation 14 = 10 + 4 to concrete amounts.
evidenceLimits: Explanatory and modeled display; demonstrates the standard but does not evaluate independent student performance.
experiences.support: Full audio-visual demonstration designed for kindergarten pre-readers.

experiences.distinctContribution: Provides an interactive concrete manipulative where the child actively drags 1 ten rod and loose unit cubes to build teen numbers like 13 and 16.
experiences.learnerAction: Drags 1 ten rod into the tens column and additional unit cubes into the ones column to build specified teen targets.
experiences.intent: Allow active tactile exploration of composing teen numbers by placing 1 ten and N ones, solidifying the two-part structure of teen quantities.
evidenceLimits: Captures concrete composition of 10 and ones, but does not capture or require symbolic equation notation (e.g. 10 + 3 = 13).
experiences.support: Visual snap-to-column guidance and audio prompts.

experiences.distinctContribution: Enables supported practice assembling symbolic equations representing teen numbers from draggable number and operator tiles.
experiences.learnerAction: Drags tiles to construct equations like 15 = 10 + 5 and 10 + 7 = 17 to match presented teen quantities.
experiences.intent: Provide scaffolded tile-assembly practice where the learner builds equations matching teen quantities partitioned into 10 plus extra ones.
evidenceLimits: Constructing equations from given tiles provides support and does not evaluate unaided generation.
experiences.support: Tile tray restricts options and provides immediate placement feedback.

experiences.distinctContribution: Applies teen number composition in fresh, untimed pictorial scenarios matching real-world items (ten pack plus loose items) to correct teen equations.
experiences.learnerAction: Views a picture of a 10-pack of crayons and 2 single crayons, then selects the matching equation (12 = 10 + 2).
experiences.intent: Apply teen decomposition knowledge to contextual situations by connecting visual representations of 10-plus-ones to their corresponding equations.
evidenceLimits: Multiple-choice format evaluates equation recognition and association rather than open construction.
experiences.support: Audio narration of prompts and equations for non-readers; untimed.

experiences.distinctContribution: Offers an unprompted closing checkpoint assessing whether the child can identify and complete teen equations without corrective hints.
experiences.learnerAction: Listens to audio-read prompts and independently selects the correct equation or missing teen part (e.g., 'Which equation shows 16?' or '10 + 8 = ___').
experiences.intent: Evaluate independent mastery of decomposing teen numbers 11-19 into 10 and ones using equations before providing model answers.
evidenceLimits: Assesses selection from multiple choices; does not assess free-form equation handwriting or spoken numeral production.
experiences.support: Live-tutor read-aloud support for pre-readers; no instructional hints prior to response submission.

gaps.reason: Evaluation is constrained to tile-building and multiple-choice selection due to kindergarten pre-reader constraints; free-form written or constructed open equation authoring is not runtime-verified.
